todays_decisions.reasoning: I agree with the Market Analyst's risk-off call (0.55). SPY is 1.12% under its 200-day, realized vol is about double its yearly level and every sector SPDR is down over 5 days, so the regime filter allows only BND, GLD, IEF and TLT. BND and IEF are wash-sale blocked and he says not to use GLD as a haven. That leaves P1, the TLT add. I resized it from $20 to $15. The Skeptic is right that this is the third TLT buy in four sessions, that it buys above both existing lots after a 2.9% five-day rise, and that TLT is still 1.11% under its own 200-day with the 12-09 FOMC inside the test. Against that, today's note is new evidence, not a repeat of yesterday's: the Market Analyst now says duration is hedging ('Treasuries are the one sleeve working') and tells the book to lean on it, and the owner wants cash used. $15 sits between yesterday's $10 and the requested $20. The Implicator's checks pass (well under the 15% cap, no wash sale, stress loss barely moves). His point that this builds one long-duration bet that the beta stress figure cannot see is why I did not approve the full $20. L4 applied: the add rests on the Market Analyst's explicit duration preference, not on diversification alone. L9 applied: TLT has its own stop. L10 applied to the Skeptic's clause objection: I rewrote TLT's second clause as a relative test (TLT's 5-day return below SPY's in a down week) and added a trend test (TLT more than 4% under its 200-day) for the rates-up, stocks-up case that the old sign test missed. L6 applied: TLT's stop is restated from the $80.85 blended cost the packet shows, and it will be restated from the new blended cost at the next run. After the buy, cash is about 50% of equity. The regime filter idles it; no invalidated position is kept because of it. Held-book review from the stop blocks (L7): there are no stop_alerts and nothing is NEAR or TRIPPED. CARG has no guidance cut or 8-K. DPZ is still on the menu (rank 3), CFO is above net income, and there is no confirmed guidance cut; the BNP Underperform/$295 initiation and the EVP sale are sentiment and not stored clauses. IDXX, INCY, MSCI and VRSN have no 8-K in the window (L2 dates from the News Analyst's filings check). KR's cyber incident is unconfirmed, and its 12-03 report enters the 5-day window on 11-25, so no adds. SAM is on the menu with no guidance-cut 8-K, but it is the nearest to its stop and its 11-19 8-K 5.02 is still unread. TLT's duration clause is unmet (TLT 5d +2.91% and IEF +1.55% while SPY 5d -2.39%). Staples is still a favored sector, so KR's and SAM's sector premise holds. I disagree with the Proposer's implicit hold of DPZ on one point. Its 'long-term-taxable winner' reason is wrong: the only lot opened 10-20 and is short-term until 2027-10-21 (Skeptic). The $300 stop also protects only the fill, 18.4% under the mark. I cannot originate a trim, so I re-anchored DPZ's stop to $325, above the fill, through thesis_updates. I also fixed SAM's stale 'joins WMT and KR' text (L3/L6) and IDXX's undated insider-sale line (L6).

trades.thesis: A defensive Treasury sleeve while the regime filter allows only BND, GLD, IEF and TLT. The Market Analyst (risk-off, 11-24) says Treasuries are the one sleeve working and tells the book to lean on duration. TLT is used because IEF and BND are wash-sale blocked, not because he prefers it over them. TLT tracks 20+ year Treasuries and is judged not substantially identical to the blocked IEF. It is the most volatile Treasury option and carries long-duration rate risk that the beta-based equity stress test does not show. The 12-09 FOMC falls inside its 20-session test. Built in three small buys (11-20, 11-23, 11-24) and resized below the request because the evidence for the hedge is short and TLT is still under its 200-day. It is the only bond holding and has its own stop (L9). ETF, no earnings events.
trades.invalidation: TLT closes at or below $76.30 (about 5.6% under the $80.85 blended cost before the 11-24 add; restate from the blended cost after this add at the next run), or at a run where SPY's 5-day return is negative, TLT's 5-day return is below SPY's (duration not hedging), or the Market Analyst's figures show TLT more than 4% under its 200-day (rates trend against the position).
